title: A Free RAW Editor That Teaches You How to Edit
excerpt: Aftershoot launched Photon, a free RAW editor with an AI Coach that explains why each adjustment matters — built for photographers who shoot RAW but never learned what the sliders do.

title: Two Companies Now Ship Twice as Many Cameras as the Entire Mirrorless Market
excerpt: IDC's numbers show DJI and Insta360 together ship more than twice as many cameras as all mirrorless makers combined — while mirrorless itself holds steady, selling fewer bodies at higher prices.

title: Speed in a Photograph Is About Perception, Not Shutter Speed
excerpt: Aviation photographer Simone Marulli says capturing speed starts with energy, not settings — the aircraft's angle, its position in the frame, and the tension in its wings do the storytelling.
